avis.texte: I loved Avene's Trixera moisturizer, but of course they discontinued it. I've been searching for something similar and this is the closest thing I've been able to find. What I loved about the Avene is that is was thin, not too thick, fragrance free, didn't have shea butter or alcohol, and was somewhat economical as if came in a larger container. The finish was also very dewy and had this sort of slip to it that I really like. This Exomega cream checks most of the same boxes except it is a thicker cream consistency. Either way it will have to do for now. The pump feature is nice and you can use it for face and body. I consider the price to be ok as you get 400 ml vs me spending $60 on a little jar of face cream from Sephora. If you have sensitive dry/dehydrated skin, but don't necessarily want Cetaphil or Cerave this would be worth checking out.

avis.titre: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The best cream for sensitive skin and eczema!
avis.texte: I have tried many creams to soothe dry and irritated skin, and A-Derma Exomega Control has really made the difference. I use it mainly for my son who has atopic skin, and from the first week I noticed less redness, less itching and a much softer skin. ✅ Rich but not sticky texture ✅ It has no strong fragrance (ideal for sensitive skin) ✅ It absorbs well and leaves an immediate soothing sensation ✅ It's very good!

avis.titre: Beware: Formula was updated and it made everything worse.
avis.texte: Just wanted to make everyone aware of this situation: Aderma decided to update the formula with no explanation. If you try to buy this cream you know get 'Exomega Control' (and this is not a shipment error, I have tried in multiple stores both in person and online). The product is different, the ingredients are different. I had been using the old formula for the last 5 years and it was my salvation against eczema. Like many, this was the only cream that controlled it. Not being able to find the old formula actually caused me some flare ups and the new formula just does not feel the same way and cannot be applied as constantly as the old one as it is more oily. I really hope Aderma changes their mind and keeps the old one available as well, many of us count on that. Moreover we (the clients) should not give them a pass just because their old product was the best cream ever. I am attaching pictures of the ingredients on both (I kept an old bottle) for you to make your own judgement.
